tools.name: list_tattoo_options
tools.description: Return the style, placement and color identifiers accepted by the Inkspira generator.

tools.name: create_tattoo_preview_link
tools.description: Build a prefilled Inkspira generator link from a non-identifying tattoo motif. The link opens a form for review. Image generation happens only after the user signs in and chooses to generate. Do not send names, exact personal dates, contact details, image URLs, or other identifying details.
